trips.title: Trips
trips.subtitle: Register trips and see the transport tax due on each one.
trips.created: Trip for {{plate}} saved as a draft. Tax due: {{amount}}.

empty.title: No trips yet
empty.body: Create a trip to calculate its transport tax.

noVehicles.title: Add a vehicle first
noVehicles.body: Every trip is made by one of your registered vehicles.

form.title: New trip
form.subtitle: Enter the trip details. The trip cost and taxes are calculated as you go.
form.editSubtitle: Drafts can be changed until their bill ID is generated.

tax.title: Trip cost and taxes
tax.distanceNote: Distance is estimated from city coordinates (straight line × {{factor}} road factor). Trip cost = rate × distance × quantity; the taxes are percentages of it.

items.title: Cargo items
items.name: Item
items.chooseVehicle: Select a vehicle first. Its capacity limits what it can carry.
items.none: No cargo items were recorded for this trip.

deleteDialog.title: Delete trip #{{id}}?
deleteDialog.body: This draft and its cargo items will be deleted. This can't be undone.

draft.body: Generate an E-Sali bill ID to pay this trip's taxes. They're calculated at the current tax rates when the bill is issued.

pending.label: E-Sali bill ID
pending.hint: Pay this bill ID from any mobile banking app (Bankak or another bank), then refresh to confirm the payment.
pending.notPaid: Not paid yet. The trip stays pending until the payment is confirmed.

paid.title: Tax paid
paid.body: E-Sali confirmed the payment and the trip certificate has been issued.

header.ministry: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning
header.title: Road Transport Tax Payment Certificate

certificate.footer: This certificate was issued electronically by the Masarat system and needs no signature or stamp.

cargo.title: Cargo manifest
cargo.footer: This page is part of the certificate above and is only valid with it.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.scope: Tax collection across all fleet owners
dashboard.subtitle: All fleet owners · Updated {{time}}
dashboard.empty: No data for this period yet.

kpis.collectionRateHint: Paid share of the amount billed in the period

regenerate.title: Regenerate demo data?
regenerate.body: This deletes the demo fleet companies and all their vehicles, trips, bills and certificates, then creates them again with fresh dates. Anything added by hand to a demo company is deleted too; other companies' data is kept. Anyone signed in as a demo company is signed out.

taxes.title: Tax rates
taxes.subtitle: The taxes charged on each trip, as a percentage of its trip cost.
taxes.example: On a trip cost of {{cost}}, the fleet owner pays {{amount}} in taxes.
taxes.appliesTo: New rates apply to bills issued from now on. Bills already issued keep the rates they were issued with.
